content:
mira: Hey team — Mira here, started today! I brought a tiny moss terrarium that lives on my desk (3B). If anyone wants to trade desk plants/oddities or swap care tips, I’m game. Also curious if anyone collects tiny puzzles or mechanical trinkets? :seedling: :jigsaw:

juno: Welcome, Mira!! 3B is right by my window, will swing by with a spare tiny screwdriver and some plant food. My desk is a shrine to novelty keycaps and minifigs. :wave:

noel: hi Mira, welcome! I have a tiny zen sand tray that doubles as a stress toy. also down for a desk-swap day. 

pepper-bot: Hello Mira — onboarding checklist attached: 1) Badge granted ✅ 2) Slack channels added ✅ 3) Desk location recorded (3B) ✅ If you want a plant-care reminder, say `@pepper-bot set plant-water 7d`

mira: Thanks @juno and @noel! @pepper-bot neat — set `plant-water 10d` please. I’ve never had to schedule watering before haha.

samira: welcome!! tiny-puzzle collector here — will bring a 3-piece metal puzzle tomorrow. also curious: mini swap poll — do you prefer plants, puzzles, or snacks as desk trade items? React with :seedling:, :jigsaw:, or :pretzel:

juno: :seedling: for sure — plants win from me.

noel: :jigsaw: — puzzles over everything.

mira: :seedling: (but also snacks are dangerous to my willpower)

samira: looks like plants and puzzles are neck-and-neck. i’ll organize a little table by the kitchen tomorrow afternoon for swaps. :sparkles:

mira: love it — thank you! Also if anyone has tips for keeping moss happy indoors, I’m all ears. low light, high humidity recs welcome. :)

juno: mist it lightly, keep in a shallow dish with water nearby, avoid direct sun. and don’t overpot it — tiny ecosystem loves cozy.

noel: also happy to lend a humidity dome if needed. I’ve got a spare from a past project.

mira: amazing, thanks everyone — see you at the swap table! :heart:
